purpose: Authenticated client-facing view of enquiries, classification tags, follow-up drafts awaiting approval and booked appointments, scoped to a single tenant.
permissionsRequired: Read/update leads for the configured tenant only

testCases.description: Staff user logs in and lists leads
testCases.expectedOutcome: Only leads with the configured tenant_id are returned

testCases.description: Call the leads API with another tenant's id using a valid token

knownLimitations: Contract only: Angular + Spring Boot implementation not yet built (Phase B).
No role hierarchy; all allow-listed staff have equal access.
rollbackApproach: Disable the dashboard route in config; leads remain accessible via Google Sheets sync or database export.
